title: Instrument & Controls Technician, Solar - Central Texas

cond_0001.intro: The Instrument and Controls Specialist is responsible to support execute and provide configuration and maintenance services for the Process Control System and other automation systems at the [Company name masked] Facilities for both Battery Energy Storage and Solar assets. Ensure facility controls automation and machinery function safely, efficiently, reliably and within budgetary limits, utilizing allocated resources, with the objective of meeting business goals for production while minimizing unscheduled equipment down time. Provide day-to-day maintenance activities.
cond_0001.responsibilities:
Monitor site performance via SCADA, Remote Desktop and SAP
Provide all weather station, trackers, UPS, PC, Switch, Modem, PLC, HMI, AC system onsite preventative maintenance associated with the plant process control systems to comply with regulation, best practice, contractual, and business needs.
Have working knowledge of solid-state circuitry and programmable controllers.
Be able to work with various PC programs and operating systems.
Perform calibration, preventive maintenance and testing of equipment.
Troubleshoot, diagnose problems and repair plant mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical systems.
Responsible for providing onsite services for all Controls Systems on the Process Control Network.
Responsible for performance and maintaining 24x7 uptime of Control Systems including parts consumption system support and communications to Control Systems and other associated devices.
Responsible for Process Control PLC SCADA channels including hardware and software communication.
Responsible overall performance and maintenance of controllers that process and control many of the field devices for the operation of the facility including I/O and related system components that connect field devices to the Control Systems.
cond_0001.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Graduate or GED Equivalent
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g. SCADA, Ladder Logic (PLC), etc.)
Comprehensive experience in the operation and maintenance of Control Systems
Good understanding of ESD systems, PLC's, control systems, and UPS systems
Comprehensive experience in the Instrumentation field with a strong knowledge base of field instrumentation, fire, vibration switches/transducers, PLC's and SCADA systems
Experience with plant shutdown/turnaround activities
Strong PC skills to perform calibration and testing on various types of equipment; competent in MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, etc.
Preferred Requirements
Associates/Tech. Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation or Automation Technology
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Renewable Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g. SCADA, Ladder Logic (PLC), etc.)
Networking experience, Windows, Linux, DOS, C++ Communication bus, IOT experience

cond_0072.intro: The Instrument and Controls Specialist works alongside the team to support, execute, and provide configuration and maintenance services for the Process Control System and other automation systems at [Company name masked] facilities, covering both Battery Energy Storage and Solar assets. Together, we help ensure facility controls, automation, and machinery function safely, efficiently, and reliably within budgetary limits, with the shared goal of meeting production targets while minimizing unscheduled equipment downtime.
cond_0072.responsibilities:
Monitor site performance via SCADA, Remote Desktop, and SAP.
Coordinate preventative maintenance for all weather stations, trackers, UPS, PC, Switch, Modem, PLC, HMI, and AC systems associated with plant process control systems to comply with regulations, best practices, contractual, and business needs.
Apply working knowledge of solid-state circuitry and programmable controllers.
Work with various PC programs and operating systems.
Collaborate on calibration, preventive maintenance, and testing of equipment.
Support troubleshooting, diagnosis, and repair of plant mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical systems.
Coordinate onsite services for all Controls Systems on the Process Control Network.
Share responsibility for maintaining 24x7 uptime of Control Systems, including parts consumption, system support, and communications to Control Systems and associated devices.
Help maintain Process Control PLC SCADA channels, including hardware and software communication.
Work with the team to maintain controllers that process and control field devices for facility operations, including I/O and related system components connecting field devices to the Control Systems.
cond_0072.requirements:
Comprehensive experience in the operation and maintenance of Control Systems.
Good understanding of ESD systems, PLCs, control systems, and UPS systems.
Comprehensive experience in the Instrumentation field with strong knowledge of field instrumentation, fire and vibration switches/transducers, PLCs, and SCADA systems.
Experience with plant shutdown/turnaround activities.
Strong PC skills to perform calibration and testing on various types of equipment; familiarity with MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, etc.
High School Graduate or GED Equivalent.
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g., SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC).
Networking experience with Windows, Linux, DOS, C++, communication bus, and IoT.
Associates/Tech. Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, or Automation Technology.
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Renewable Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g., SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC).

Provide day-to-day maintenance activities.
cond_0227.responsibilities:
Monitor site performance via SCADA, Remote Desktop and SAP
Provide all weather station, trackers, UPS, PC, Switch, Modem, PLC, HMI, AC system onsite preventative maintenance associated with the plant process control systems to comply with regulation, best practice, contractual, and business needs.
Have working knowledge of solid-state circuitry and programmable controllers.
Be able to work with various PC programs and operating systems.
Perform calibration, preventive maintenance and testing of equipment.
Troubleshoot, diagnose problems and repair plant mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical systems.
Responsible for providing onsite services for all Controls Systems on the Process Control Network.
Responsible for performance and maintaining 24x7 uptime of Control Systems including parts consumption system support and communications to Control Systems and other associated devices.
Responsible for Process Control PLC SCADA channels including hardware and software communication.
Responsible overall performance and maintenance of controllers that process and control many of the field devices for the operation of the facility including I/O and related system components that connect field devices to the Control Systems.
cond_0227.requirements:
High School Graduate or GED Equivalent; Associate's/Technical Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation or Automation Technology required; advanced degree strongly preferred.
Minimum 3 years of demonstrated expertise in industrial automation in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems.
Proven track record in industrial automation in the Renewable Energy Sector or similar business, with deep knowledge of complex Control Systems such as SCADA, Ladder Logic (PLC), etc.
Extensive expertise in the operation and maintenance of Control Systems.
Advanced knowledge of ESD systems, PLCs, control systems, and UPS systems.
Substantial expertise in the Instrumentation field with a strong command of field instrumentation, fire and vibration switches/transducers, PLCs, and SCADA systems.
Proven track record with plant shutdown/turnaround activities.
Strong command of PC skills to perform calibration and testing on various types of equipment, with demonstrated proficiency in MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, and similar tools.
Solid expertise in networking, Windows, Linux, DOS, C++, communication bus, and IoT technologies.

You will regularly connect with site teams and communicate across groups to keep day-to-day maintenance activities on track.
cond_0258.responsibilities:
Monitor site performance via SCADA, Remote Desktop, and SAP.
Provide all weather station, trackers, UPS, PC, Switch, Modem, PLC, HMI, and AC system onsite preventative maintenance associated with the plant process control systems to comply with regulation, best practice, contractual, and business needs.
Have working knowledge of solid-state circuitry and programmable controllers.
Work with various PC programs and operating systems.
Perform calibration, preventive maintenance, and testing of equipment.
Troubleshoot, diagnose problems, and repair plant mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical systems — actively communicating findings and status to relevant team members.
Provide onsite services for all Controls Systems on the Process Control Network, staying in regular contact with stakeholders to clarify requirements and walk them through issues.
Maintain 24x7 uptime of Control Systems including parts consumption, system support, and communications to Control Systems and other associated devices.
Handle Process Control PLC SCADA channels including hardware and software communication.
Oversee overall performance and maintenance of controllers that process and control field devices for facility operation, including I/O and related system components that connect field devices to the Control Systems.
cond_0258.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Graduate or GED Equivalent
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g., SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC)
Good understanding of ESD systems, PLCs, control systems, and UPS systems
Comprehensive experience in the Instrumentation field with strong knowledge of field instrumentation, fire and vibration switches/transducers, PLCs, and SCADA systems
Strong PC skills to perform calibration and testing on various types of equipment; competent in MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, etc.
Networking experience with Windows, Linux, DOS, C++, communication bus, and IoT
Experience with plant shutdown/turnaround activities
Preferred Requirements
Associates/Tech. Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, or Automation Technology
3+ Years of industrial automation experience specifically in the Renewable Energy Sector, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g., SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC)

cond_0310.intro: The Instrument and Controls Specialist is responsible for supporting, executing, and providing configuration and maintenance services for the Process Control System and other automation systems at [Company name masked] Facilities for both Battery Energy Storage and Solar assets. The role ensures facility controls, automation, and machinery function safely, efficiently, and reliably within budgetary limits, using allocated resources to meet production goals while minimizing unscheduled equipment downtime. Day-to-day maintenance activities are a core part of the work. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp control systems logic and the way automation and instrumentation fit together.
cond_0310.responsibilities:
Monitor site performance via SCADA, Remote Desktop and SAP
Provide all weather station, trackers, UPS, PC, Switch, Modem, PLC, HMI, AC system onsite preventative maintenance associated with the plant process control systems to comply with regulation, best practice, contractual, and business needs.
Have working knowledge of solid-state circuitry and programmable controllers.
Be able to work with various PC programs and operating systems.
Perform calibration, preventive maintenance and testing of equipment.
Troubleshoot, diagnose problems and repair plant mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical systems.
Responsible for providing onsite services for all Controls Systems on the Process Control Network.
Responsible for performance and maintaining 24x7 uptime of Control Systems including parts consumption system support and communications to Control Systems and other associated devices.
Responsible for Process Control PLC SCADA channels including hardware and software communication.
Responsible for overall performance and maintenance of controllers that process and control many of the field devices for the operation of the facility including I/O and related system components that connect field devices to the Control Systems.
cond_0310.requirements:
Minimum Requirements
High School Graduate or GED Equivalent
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems
Good understanding of ESD systems, PLCs, control systems, and UPS systems
Comprehensive experience in the Instrumentation field with a strong knowledge base of field instrumentation, fire, vibration switches/transducers, PLCs and SCADA systems
Strong PC skills to perform calibration and testing on various types of equipment; competent in MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, etc.
Experience with plant shutdown/turnaround activities
Preferred Requirements
Associates/Tech. Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation or Automation Technology
3+ Years of industrial automation experience specifically in the Renewable Energy Sector, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g. SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC)
Networking experience including Windows, Linux, DOS, C++, communication bus, and IoT

3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g., SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC)

Comprehensive experience in instrumentation, including field instrumentation, fire and vibration switches/transducers, PLCs, and SCADA systems
Strong PC skills, including MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, etc.
Experience with plant shutdown/turnaround activities
Preferred Requirements
Associate's or Technical Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, or Automation Technology
3+ Years of industrial automation experience specifically in the Renewable Energy Sector
Networking experience across Windows, Linux, DOS, C++, communication bus, and IoT

Provide day-to-day maintenance activities. People who do well in this role are often quick to grasp the logic of control systems and automation work.
cond_0445.responsibilities:
Monitor site performance via SCADA, Remote Desktop and SAP
Provide all weather station, trackers, UPS, PC, Switch, Modem, PLC, HMI, AC system onsite preventative maintenance associated with the plant process control systems to comply with regulation, best practice, contractual, and business needs.
Have working knowledge of solid-state circuitry and programmable controllers.
Be able to work with various PC programs and operating systems.
Perform calibration, preventive maintenance and testing of equipment.
Troubleshoot, diagnose problems and repair plant mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical systems.
Responsible for providing onsite services for all Controls Systems on the Process Control Network.
Responsible for performance and maintaining 24x7 uptime of Control Systems including parts consumption system support and communications to Control Systems and other associated devices.
Responsible for Process Control PLC SCADA channels including hardware and software communication.
Responsible overall performance and maintenance of controllers that process and control many of the field devices for the operation of the facility including I/O and related system components that connect field devices to the Control Systems.
cond_0445.requirements:
Comprehensive experience in the operation and maintenance of Control Systems.
Must have a good understanding and be familiar with ESD systems, PLC's, control systems, and UPS systems.
Must also have comprehensive experience in the Instrumentation field with a strong knowledge base of field instrumentation, fire, vibration switches/transducers, PLC's and SCADA systems.
Experience with plant shutdown/turnaround activities.
Must possess Strong PC skills to perform calibration and testing on various types of equipment, should be familiar with and able to use and be competent in using MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, etc.
High School Graduate or GED Equivalent.
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems.
Industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems: E.g.- SCADA, Ladder Logic (PLC), etc.
Networking experience, Windows, Linux, DOS, C++ Communication bus, IOT experience.
Associates/Tech. Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation or Automation Technology.

You will ensure facility controls, automation, and machinery operate safely, efficiently, and reliably within budget, with the goal of meeting production targets and minimizing unscheduled downtime. You will execute day-to-day maintenance activities independently.
cond_0521.responsibilities:
Monitor site performance via SCADA, Remote Desktop, and SAP.
Lead all preventative maintenance for weather stations, trackers, UPS, PC, Switch, Modem, PLC, HMI, and AC systems associated with plant process control systems, ensuring compliance with regulations, best practices, contractual, and business requirements.
Apply working knowledge of solid-state circuitry and programmable controllers.
Operate various PC programs and operating systems.
Execute calibration, preventive maintenance, and testing of equipment.
Troubleshoot, diagnose, and resolve plant mechanical, instrumentation, and electrical system issues.
Deliver onsite services for all Controls Systems on the Process Control Network.
Ensure 24x7 uptime of Control Systems, including parts consumption, system support, and communications to Control Systems and associated devices.
Own Process Control PLC SCADA channels, including hardware and software communication.
Take accountability for the overall performance and maintenance of controllers that process and manage field devices for facility operations, including I/O and related system components connecting field devices to the Control Systems.
cond_0521.requirements:
Comprehensive experience in the operation and maintenance of Control Systems.
Good understanding of and familiarity with ESD systems, PLCs, control systems, and UPS systems.
Comprehensive experience in the Instrumentation field with strong knowledge of field instrumentation, fire and vibration switches/transducers, PLCs, and SCADA systems.
Experience with plant shutdown/turnaround activities.
Strong PC skills to perform calibration and testing on various types of equipment; competent in MS Word, Excel, Visio, SAP, CMD, Linux, Windows, Terminal, etc.
High School Graduate or GED Equivalent.
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g., SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC).
Networking experience with Windows, Linux, DOS, C++, communication bus, and IoT.
Associates/Tech. Degree in Electrical, Instrumentation, or Automation Technology.
3+ Years of industrial automation experience in the Renewable Energy Sector or similar business, utilizing complex Control Systems (e.g., SCADA, Ladder Logic/PLC).
